name: aws_access_key_id_recognizer
note: AWS access key ID: 4-character prefix (AKIA long-term, ASIA temporary STS, ABIA, ACCA, A3T*) + 16 uppercase alphanumerics. Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/aws.py (pattern 1). \b added on both sides because real key IDs are exactly 20 characters. The key ID alone cannot sign requests; pair it with AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
